name: Channel member
description: One person's membership of a channel (forge 26d-3): their role there and how many of its messages they have read, which with the channel's count in the unread projection gives their unread count. Its id is <channel>-<user>

fields.name: Private
fields.description: Its channel's, copied so the row rule needs no lookup

fields.name: Channel owner
fields.description: Its channel's owner, copied so the row rule lets the owner add people to a private channel before the app has given them its access; the app gives access only when whoever made the membership is the channel's owner or a member

fields.name: Seen
fields.description: How many of the channel's messages they had when they last read it (channel.markRead)
